design.shape: One daily schedule fans out to two parallel Google branches, each feeding its own specialist agent, then a merge feeds a third synthesising agent, an HTML renderer and Gmail delivery.

agents.name: Email Triage Agent
agents.role: Sorts the last 24h of Gmail into needsReply / important / fyi / noise with a why and a dueBy, plus headline and counts.

agents.name: Day Planner Agent
agents.role: Turns today's calendar into a chronological timeline with prep notes, detects overlapping events and back-to-back blocks, and finds free focus windows.

agents.name: Chief Of Staff Agent
agents.role: Reads both specialists' structured output and writes the synthesis: headline, summary, up to four top priorities with what/when/why, watch-outs and a mood.

design.dashboard: The HTML node renders a self-contained styled document: hero with headline, summary, date and mood tag; a four-tile stat strip (meetings, booked hours, emails needing a reply, total new email); then Top priorities, Inbox needs-your-reply, Inbox worth-knowing, Today on the calendar, Focus windows and Watch out. The sorted lists come from the two specialist agents' structured output via explicit node references, so the AI writes the narrative but never the markup.
deliberateChoices: Explicit $('Node').item.json.output references downstream of the merge instead of $json, because both specialist agents emit a field named 'output' and would clash on combine.
Gmail getAll uses simple=true: subject, sender and snippet are enough for a headline-level briefing, and fetching full raw bodies for a whole day of mail is the documented out-of-memory risk.

alwaysOutputData=true on the two Aggregate nodes only. The SDK best practices warn against it as a default, but a daily briefing must still render on a day with zero new email or an empty calendar. The agent prompts absorb the empty case with '?? []' and explicit 'inbox is clear' / 'day is clear' instructions, so no redundant IF gate was added.
executeOnce=true on the Chief Of Staff Agent, the HTML renderer and the Gmail send, so one briefing is produced and delivered per run.
onError=continueRegularOutput on all three agents so one failing model call does not kill the whole briefing.
The Gmail recipient is placeholder('The inbox that should receive the briefing, ...') rather than an invented address.

credentials.policy: No credential value was invented and no credential was created. Every credential slot was declared with the SDK's newCredential('<name>') factory, which emits an empty slot for the user to fill.

serverAutoAssigned.note: Not requested by the builder. create_workflow_from_code returned an autoAssignedCredentials block: the n8n server itself bound the user's pre-existing 'n8n free OpenAI API credits' credential (type openAiApi, source 'user') to the three lmChatOpenAi nodes. This was left in place rather than stripped, since it is an existing credential belonging to the account, not a fabricated one.

friction.issue: Get-Date -AsUTC is not available on Windows PowerShell 5.1.

Invoking the helper as a child process (powershell -NoProfile -File .\mcp_call.ps1 -ArgumentsJson '{...}') mangles the double quotes inside the JSON argument. The helper's ConvertFrom-Json then silently falls back to an empty hashtable, so every call arrived with no arguments and the server answered with a misleading 'required field' validation error.
friction.resolution: Assign the JSON to a variable and call the script in-process with the call operator: $a = '{...}'; & .\mcp_call.ps1 -ToolName X -ArgumentsJson $a. This is a scaffolding gap worth adding to the workspace README alongside the other Windows fixes.

friction.issue: The argument is 'queries' (an array), not the more obvious 'query'. Cost one round trip.
friction.resolution: Batched all nine node lookups into a single queries array.

friction.issue: The Merge node's numberInputs is rejected with combineBy='combineAll'; it is only valid with combineByPosition. The type definition does not scope it, the validator does.
friction.resolution: Dropped numberInputs. Merge defaults to 2 inputs, which is what the two branches need.

friction.issue: The template is a single-quoted SDK string containing both HTML attributes and runtime n8n expressions, and the SDK forbids backtick template literals. Nested quoting is the easy way to break it.
friction.resolution: HTML attributes use double quotes; all HTML built inside {{ }} .map() calls is attribute-free (b, i, em, li only) and styled through CSS descendant selectors, so no quote level ever collides. CSS was also kept free of @media blocks so no '}}' sequence can be mistaken for an expression delimiter.

friction.issue: The server auto-bound an existing OpenAI credential to the three model nodes even though the code declared empty newCredential() slots.
friction.resolution: Recorded above under credentials.serverAutoAssigned. Not fabricated by the builder and left untouched.
